_comment: Visual-baseline fixture for the AircraftDossier Playwright spec. One fully-enriched aircraft (military F-35, US-mil hex, full metadata) used to pin the rendered dossier across the SQLite migration. Mirrors the post-enrichment shape that aircraftCache.ts writes — adsb.fi v3 raw fields PLUS the server-side enrichment fields (acType, registration, military, etc.) attached by enrichRecord before the cache write. Lat/lon chosen for visibility at the default camera (no autoRotate, no zoom).
